seo.title: WooCommerce AI chatbot for order tracking and sales | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect WooCommerce to Steps AI so your agent can answer order questions, recommend products, check stock and share checkout links on WhatsApp, Instagram and your website.

hero.title: Give your WooCommerce store an agent that knows your orders.
hero.body: Your agent reads your product catalogue and order status from WooCommerce. It answers order questions, suggests products that are in stock and sends a checkout link while the customer is still interested.
hero.reassurance: Your products and orders. Checkout on your own site. No plugin code to write.

lines.text: Yes, order 5521 is marked completed and on its way. Anything else I can help with?
Do you still have the green ceramic mug?
Yes, it is in stock. Here is the link to check out.

useCases.title: What you can do with WooCommerce connected.
useCases.intro: The agent works from your store data, so customers get answers about your real products and orders.

items.title: Answer order status questions
items.body: Customers ask about an order and the agent replies with the status from WooCommerce, on the website, WhatsApp or Instagram.

items.title: Recommend from your catalogue
items.body: The agent suggests products from your store based on what the customer says, such as budget, use or style.

items.title: Check stock before suggesting
items.body: Availability is checked in WooCommerce, so the agent does not recommend something you cannot ship.

items.title: Share a checkout link
items.body: When the customer is ready, the agent sends a link to your checkout. Payment happens on your own site.

items.title: Save shoppers who are not ready
items.body: If a customer wants to think about it, the agent saves their details to your Steps AI CRM or to HubSpot.

walkthrough.title: One conversation, from browsing to checkout.
walkthrough.intro: How a WooCommerce shopper gets help on your website.

steps.label: Understand the need
steps.customer: I want a gift for my sister. She loves cooking.
steps.agent: Lovely. Is there a budget you have in mind?
steps.note: A short question first, instead of a long product list.

steps.label: Suggest from your store
steps.agent: The cast iron pan and the spice box set both fit. Shall I show you the pan first?
steps.note: Every suggestion comes from your WooCommerce catalogue.

steps.label: Check stock
steps.agent: Yes, it is in stock and ready to ship.
steps.note: Stock is read from WooCommerce before the agent answers.

steps.label: Send to checkout
steps.agent: Here is your checkout link. You can pay on our site.
steps.note: Customers pay on your own checkout page.

setup.title: Connect WooCommerce in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect WooCommerce
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose WooCommerce. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds WooCommerce to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Let the agent use your store
items.body: Your catalogue is read in, and the agent can start answering product and order questions on every channel you have connected.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Customers pay on your own WooCommerce checkout. Steps AI does not process payments.
Discount sync and some newer workflow templates are built for Shopify first. Ask us which ones support WooCommerce today.
In the workflow builder, WooCommerce can be chosen as the app that starts a workflow.

items.q: Do I need to install code on my WordPress site?
items.a: No code to write. For the chat widget on WordPress there is a ready-made plugin, and the WooCommerce connection is set up from Resources, then Apps.

items.q: Can the agent look up an order?
items.a: Yes. With WooCommerce connected and switched on, the agent can share an order status with the customer who asks.

items.q: Can customers pay in the chat?
items.a: The agent shares a checkout link, and customers pay on your own WooCommerce checkout page.
